name: Gorgias MCP
description:
Gorgias is the AI-powered customer experience platform for ecommerce brands. This connector gives your AI assistant secure, OAuth-based access to your Gorgias account so you can audit your setup, pull voice-of-customer insights, and take real helpdesk actions from chat.

What you can do:

Tickets: search and read tickets with full message history, reply to customers, post internal notes, update status and priority, and add tags.
Macros and rules: find stale or duplicate macros, create and update macros, apply them to tickets, and manage automation rules.
AI Agent: audit and tune your AI Agent — tone of voice, handover topics, support actions (including creating new ones from templates), channel enablement — and preview replies safely in test mode before going live.
Knowledge: review, draft, and publish Help Center guidance that powers your AI Agent.
Customers and team: look up customer profiles and review your agent roster.
Insights: query your helpdesk data to surface contact-reason trends, frustration patterns, return reasons, and CSAT drivers.

How it works: sign in with your Gorgias credentials through the standard browser OAuth flow — no API keys to copy. All calls run against your own Gorgias account, as your Gorgias user. Have your Gorgias subdomain (the part before .gorgias.com) handy when you connect.

Available on all Gorgias Helpdesk plans.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Gorgias MCP to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Gorgias MCP to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.gorgias.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Gorgias MCP MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Gorgias MCP lists 88 MCP tools, including add_internal_note, add_tags, ai_agent_setup_completion, apply_macro, archive_macro, convert_to_advanced_view, create_action_from_template, create_draft_guidance, create_draft_skill, create_help_center_article, create_macro, and create_message.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Gorgias MCP?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Gorgias MCP in customer-support on the Manufact MCP catalog include Assembled, Brainfish, ClearFeed, Conduit, and DevRev.

_published_faq.name: Does Gorgias MCP MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Gorgias MCP requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Gorgias MCP is developed by Gorgias. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
